sources.title: Why We Ask Why: The Science of Explanation and the Human Drive to Understand
sources.consulted_scope: Author book presentation only; full book not read.
sources.note: Reference on explanation-seeking. It is not evidence of outcomes in Rarity Funnel.

sources.title: How laypeople evaluate scientific explanations containing jargon
sources.consulted_scope: Author laboratory abstract and bibliographic record; full article not read.
sources.note: The reported experiments distinguish satisfaction with explanations from comprehensibility. Application to Rarity Funnel is an editorial question, not a tested effect.

sources.title: The hazards of explanation: overgeneralization in the face of exceptions
sources.consulted_scope: Author laboratory abstract and bibliographic record; full article not read.
sources.note: The reported category-learning experiments show limits of generalization when exceptions matter. They do not demonstrate a causal effect of any Rarity Funnel passage.
